Corporate group tours at the Château de Voltaire, on the Geneva border

Team building, incentives, offsites and client events: a private guided visit of Voltaire’s château, fifteen minutes from Geneva Airport, in English, French, German or Russian.

Every tour includes Voltaire’s gardens

A historical château for your Geneva business trip

The Château de Voltaire stands in Ferney-Voltaire, just across the Geneva border. For companies, international organisations and agencies based in or visiting Geneva, it is the closest historical château for a cultural break that fits into a working day.

I design each corporate group tour around your programme: a short private visit before a seminar, a team-building historical tour of Ferney-Voltaire, or the cultural highlight of an incentive trip. Voltaire, who turned a village into a thriving town of watchmakers and welcomed all of Europe to his table, is a natural inspiration for teams.

Request a Group Quote

Formats for companies

Team building: a historical tour of Ferney-Voltaire

An “Enlightenment Rally” through the château grounds and the town: teams solve riddles drawn from Voltaire’s life and letters. A team building activity in Ferney-Voltaire that is cultural, active and genuinely fun.

A château tour around your corporate event

Pair a private tour of the Château de Voltaire with your seminar, board meeting or client event in the Geneva area: before the first session, between meetings or as a closing visit. I adapt the timing to your agenda.

Geneva incentive tours to a historical château

Reward your teams or clients with an exclusive guided visit of a historical château, a short drive from Geneva. Ideal for incentive programmes and for delegations visiting international organisations.

Why companies choose this tour

  • 15 minutes from Geneva Airport (GVA) and Palexpo, 20 from the city centre
  • Tours in English, French, German and Russian for international teams
  • Large groups split into sub-groups with coordinated timings
  • A quote and invoice in your company’s name
  • One contact from first request to the day itself

Agencies, DMCs and event planners

Meetings, incentives, conferences and events (MICE): I work with agencies and destination management companies organising programmes in Geneva and the Pays de Gex. Tell me your dates, group size and languages and I will send a tailored proposal.

Questions from companies

How large can a corporate group be?

Up to about 30 people per guided group. Larger groups are split into sub-groups with coordinated timings, so everyone enjoys the visit in comfortable conditions.

Can the tour be combined with our event in Geneva?

Yes. Ferney-Voltaire is just across the border, about 20 minutes from central Geneva, so a visit fits easily before, between or after your sessions.

Do you invoice companies?

Yes. You receive a clear quote and an invoice in your company’s name. The monument’s admission fees are shown separately.

How far ahead should we book?

Ideally four to six weeks ahead for corporate groups, especially in spring and early summer.

Planning a team event near Geneva?

Send me your dates, group size and languages: I will reply within 48 hours with a programme and a quote.
